podcast.body: This album was released on February 28, 2000. In retrospect, Noel Gallagher believed the band should have taken a year off to regroup before making this record, suggesting it contributed to worsening internal tensions. "Another track from Standing on the Shoulder of Giants, a record that Noel Gallagher says really should have never been made."

podcast.body: This was the band's fourth studio album, released on February 28th, 2000. Noel Gallagher later expressed regret about its creation, believing the band should have taken a year-long break instead of recording it amidst rising tensions. "Standing on the Shoulder of Giants came out on February 28th, 2000."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
